description: Transparent terrain-routing and drainage interaction assumptions for research demonstration only. These are not measured GHMC or HMWSSB hydraulic parameters.
water_body_treatment: Water-body cells are retained as terrain-routing sinks. Incoming prototype surface water is retained in the cell; no tank storage, spillway capacity, operating rule, or measured water level is assigned.
notes: routing_fraction is a deterministic prototype routing fraction, not a calibrated hydraulic transfer parameter.
drainage_capture_fraction and drainage_effectiveness are screening assumptions applied only where processed nala geometries intersect the modeling grid.
maximum_prototype_drainage_removal_m3_per_cell is an explicit numerical cap for this demonstration, not a measured drainage capacity.
